# clio erase

IRREVERSIBLE compliance erasure (DEK destruction); distinct from `discard` and hygiene cleanup

## Usage

```
clio erase --subject S --basis B --request R [--reason-code C] --confirm [--actor harness|system] [--bank BANK] [--output json|text]
```

## Description

compliance erasure is IRREVERSIBLE (DEK destruction) and is distinct from `discard` and hygiene cleanup

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--subject S` | text |  | Names the data subject whose key is destroyed; `cli_write_portability::erase_call` passes it to the `erase_request` tool as `subject_id`. |
| `--basis B` | text |  | Records the legal basis for erasure; `cli_write_portability::erase_call` passes it to the `erase_request` tool as `legal_basis`. |
| `--request R` | text |  | Identifies the erasure request; `cli_write_portability::erase_call` passes it to the `erase_request` tool as `request_id`. |
| `--reason-code C` | text | `COMPLIANCE_CRYPTO_SHRED` | Records the reason code for erasure; `cli_write_portability::erase_call` passes it to the `erase_request` tool as `reason_code`, and `clio_compliance` defaults it to `DEFAULT_REASON_CODE`. |
| `--confirm` |  |  | Passes the confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::require_confirm` enforces before `cli_write_portability::erase_call` runs the erasure. |
| `--dry-run` |  |  | Previews the irreversible erasure with zero writes; `cli_write_portability::erase_call` returns a `WriteCall::Preview`. |
| `--actor harness\|system` | enum: harness, system |  | Selects the erasure actor that the `erase_request` tool accepts as `harness` or `system`; `cli_write_portability::erase_call` passes it through `cli_read_args::base_args`. |
| `--bank BANK` | text |  | Scopes the command to one bank; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and the write scope defaults to `default`. |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--db PATH` | text |  | Overrides the store address that `db_target::resolve_target` opens; config and environment decide it when absent. |
| `--backend sqlite\|postgres` | enum: sqlite, postgres |  | Selects the store backend that `db_target::resolve_target` hands to the resolver; config or the address decides it when absent. |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

```
clio erase --subject subj-1 --basis "DSAR" --request req-1 --confirm --actor system --db ./memory.db
```

preview, zero writes
```
clio erase --subject subj-1 --basis "DSAR" --request req-2 --dry-run
```

other basis, actor, and reason code
```
clio erase --subject subj-2 --basis "GDPR" --request req-3 --reason-code AUDITED_SHRED --confirm --actor harness --bank bank-2
```
